_note: Registration snippet — AUTHORING-BRIEF 'Registration protocol'. Content
agents do not touch content/manifest.js, content/manifest.json or
server/lib/rules.php; the integrator applies this and deletes the file.
ORDER MATTERS: r10 is the TENTH region of the fabulae track and must sit
after r09 in the manifest's regions array — js/app.js regionIndex() reads
that order and feeds it to the phase engine as the ONE difficulty input
(DESIGN §6). Applied out of order, Regiō X plays easier than Regiō IX.
APPLY AFTER the R7-R9 snippets, which a parallel author owns.
r10 is a DUEL region (three phases: caterva 3/26 + clamor 3/30 + fuga
2/22, hp 8 over 78 phase-seconds). Legacy single-phase tuning in the
content file is hp 8 / 55 s, kept because rules.php reads it and because
a client without js/boss-phases.js must still be able to fight.
bossMinMs 15000 — the same floor every duel region uses. The fight is
LONGER than r01-r04's, and a longer fight cannot be forged FASTER: the
phase seconds are ceilings, not durations, so the floor does not move.
quizKey carries the same three keys per row as r03-r06: rules.php stores
{q, a}, and `correct` is always 0 against the boss.quiz order in
content/fabulae-r10.js. Every word is a vocabulary entry WITH a picture
in the capitulum named by `from`, which is what app.js bossWords() needs.
r10 is a NEW region: its content id IS its progressId, so it needs no
entry in rule_region_aliases().
XP mirrors r05/r06 exactly (fight 30, quiz 10 each, <=1 wrong of 5
passes); the step XP is left to RULE_DEFAULT_STEP_XP as in every earlier
fabulae region.
